rules: Telemetry drop-offs are clamped at 100% and adjusted to exclude the known double-count defect on step four using a pre-defined offset; survey responses are normalized by applying a skew correction factor of 0.85 derived from sample distribution analysis; moderated session data is interpolated between persona behaviors using weighted averages based on session duration; all values are rounded to one decimal place at output stage.
invariants: Output must contain exactly one funnel stage per telemetry step, all drop-off percentages sum to 100% across steps, every persona session has a defined behavior segment, and all derived metrics match totals in the raw survey data through reconciliation checks; these are verified via cross-tabulated validation scripts in the pipeline.
